description: This Java source file defines a custom ArrayAdapter named CustomArrayAdapter used to populate and manage list items in a ListView, supporting expandable content with custom layout inflation, image processing, and view updates.

classes.name: CustomArrayAdapter
classes.description: A custom ArrayAdapter for handling expandable list items with layout customization and image processing.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Overrides the base method to provide custom view for each list item, populating data, managing layout parameters, and handling expand/collapse states.

methods.name: getCroppedBitmap
methods.description: Creates a circular cropped version of the provided bitmap for thumbnail display.
